# Swap USDC — USD Coin Swap Reference

> Exchange Circle's USD Coin (USDC) — the reserve-backed, multi-chain USD stablecoin — for ETH, USDT and other assets through a non-custodial decentralized exchange.

## Key Facts
- Asset: USDC (USD Coin) — USD-pegged stablecoin issued by Circle, backed by cash and short-dated US Treasuries
- Network: multi-chain (Ethereum, Base, Solana, Arbitrum, Polygon and more), native and bridged variants
- Ethereum contract: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1D19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas + price impact; spending USDC needs a one-time approval
- Common route: USDC -> ETH / USDT
